community_text:
[Rating: 3/10] A novel character progression system doesn't outweight swingy gameplay, trite writing, and cliche theming.

[Rating: 3/10] dice rolling with too less mitigation... this is no fun and just randomness. Not sure why this deserves such high rating. there are much better games available with the theme and mechanism.

[Rating: 3/10] Rulebook is trash, as well as art, playability and design. Don't waste your money nor time, it's not worth it

[Rating: 4/10] Lots of wasted potential here. The basic gameplay would be swift, and rather boring, the interesting bits are in the semi-random side quests, special action cards, and power ups, which, unfortunately, mostly do not boost your regular actions, but instead massively inflate your turn at the cost of other player’s waning patience. The attempts at humour are mostly off target, and the artwork, apart from the map, rather misses the mark.

[Rating: 4/10] On our play there was no tension. Compared to Iberia, which we played shortly before, pretty meh.

[Rating: 4/10] This is a Castle Panic Advanced. If they test played it with different groups of players a couple of more times, it would be a better game. The rulebook is a mess and you have to assume things. During the game play, I am wondering if it's a game for children or grown-ups. It's something in-between. Not necessarily a bad thing. It feels unfinished and needs some modifications to be completed.   We had fun playing it but it won't hit the table that often.

[Rating: 5/10] Fate:DoG is an interesting tower defence game with a campy nordic theme.  If you're into the vibe it gives off, I can see it being a winner.  I wasn't, so I thought the game was OK and similar to a lot of other co-op tower defence games I've played before.   Do I need to own it?  No.  Would I play it again if someone was jonesing for it?  Sure.

[Rating: 5/10] Wir haben es zweimal gespielt und hatten bereits nach der zweiten Partie das Gefühl, alles gesehen zu haben. Auch die Aufteilung auf der Karte, die nötig ist, sorgt dafür, dass man oft Entscheidungen ohne große Absprache trifft, weil man dort sowieso alleine ist, was bei einem Koop-Spiel nicht so toll ist. Ich denke, dem Spiel fehlen Szenarien und mehr Varianz durch ein modulares Board oder Ähnliches. Wir haben es nach zwei Partien wieder verkauft. Schade, denn es sieht gut aus.

[Rating: 5/10] Rating could go up - it's partly based on the current alpha implementation on BGA and I think it may still be a bit buggy as there were times I couldn't do what I thought I should be able to.  I do like having the cards available to play and the different things they let the characters do.

[Rating: 5/10] Nice game, but - suboptimal rulebook (no explanation how mana works, several vague points) - too much downtime - too much management (monster movement, endless dice throwing) -> could be better as pc-game without that cumbersome "work" - way too long (can play two or three rounds of pandemic in the same time).
